name: omarchy-promo
description: Video promocional de los temas de Omarchy de thealejandro y omarchy-island (Remotion)

scripts.render:h:es: remotion render Promo-es out/omarchy-promo-es.raw.mp4 && bash scripts/finish.sh out/omarchy-promo-es.raw.mp4 out/omarchy-promo-es.mp4
scripts.render:h:en: remotion render Promo-en out/omarchy-promo-en.raw.mp4 && bash scripts/finish.sh out/omarchy-promo-en.raw.mp4 out/omarchy-promo-en.mp4
scripts.render:v:es: remotion render Reel-es out/omarchy-reel-es.raw.mp4 && bash scripts/finish.sh out/omarchy-reel-es.raw.mp4 out/omarchy-reel-es.mp4
scripts.render:v:en: remotion render Reel-en out/omarchy-reel-en.raw.mp4 && bash scripts/finish.sh out/omarchy-reel-en.raw.mp4 out/omarchy-reel-en.mp4
scripts.render: npm run render:h:es && npm run render:h:en
scripts.render:vertical: npm run render:v:es && npm run render:v:en
scripts.poster:es: remotion still Poster-es out/poster-es.png && ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -i out/poster-es.png -q:v 2 out/poster-es.jpg && rm out/poster-es.png
scripts.cover:es: remotion still Cover-es out/cover-es.png && ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -i out/cover-es.png -q:v 2 out/cover-es.jpg && rm out/cover-es.png
scripts.poster:en: remotion still Poster-en out/poster-en.png && ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -i out/poster-en.png -q:v 2 out/poster-en.jpg && rm out/poster-en.png
scripts.cover:en: remotion still Cover-en out/cover-en.png && ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -i out/cover-en.png -q:v 2 out/cover-en.jpg && rm out/cover-en.png
scripts.poster: npm run poster:es && npm run poster:en && npm run cover:es && npm run cover:en
scripts.build: npm run render && npm run render:vertical && npm run poster
